headline: Turn places on a map into presence automations
intro: Define home, work, school, or any other place as a zone, then use person and device tracker locations to detect arrivals and departures. Home Assistant creates a special 100 m home zone during onboarding; other zones can be placed and resized on the map, or configured in YAML.
highlights: Set a center point and radius for each place you want to track
Trigger automations when people or tracked devices enter or leave a zone
Mark a zone passive to keep it available for automations without showing it in the frontend or using it for device tracker state

flow.title: From a place to a presence response
stages: Create a zone on the map
Trigger an automation on arrival or departure
